name: Equinix SY9x Rosehill xScale data center
developer: Equinix / PGIM Real Estate joint venture
notes: Equinix lists SY9x as its first Sydney xScale site in Rosehill near Parramatta; third-party and trade sources report the Rosehill facility provides more than 14 MW initially and more than 28 MW at full build.

name: Equinix SY10x / Grand Avenue Data Centre Expansion, Rosehill
notes: NSW Planning Portal approved SSD-53338465 on 2024-12-16 for expansion of an existing Rosehill data centre at 8 Grand Avenue; SEARs identify the applicant as Equinix Hyperscale 2 (SY10), and listings identify the resulting SY10x facility at about 28 MW.

name: Microsoft Kemps Creek Data Centre
notes: NSW Planning Portal approved SSD-10101987 on 2023-07-13 for two data storage buildings at Kemps Creek. Post-approval correspondence names Microsoft Datacentre (Australia) Pty Ltd and refers to Operational Environmental Management Plan for SYD05 and SYD06.

name: STACK SYD01 Data Centre, Erskine Park
notes: NSW Planning Portal shows the Penrith SSD-82211208 project in assessment/more-information-required for a 450 MW operating-capacity data centre at Erskine Park. NSW Government's IDA list also names STACK's 78 Lockwood Road Data Centre in Penrith.

name: Mamre Road Data Centre Campus
developer: Undisclosed / project applicant not visible in search result
notes: NSW Planning Portal shows SSD-92743706 on exhibition for a 1 GW data centre campus in Penrith/Kemps Creek, comprising six four-storey data centre buildings plus cooling, backup generation, diesel storage, internal roads, and parking.

name: Stockland Fife Kemps Creek data centre project
notes: NSW Government listed Stockland Fife Kemps Creek among data centre projects entering the Investment Delivery Authority pipeline for Penrith; public source did not expose a project-specific planning page or capacity in the searched material.

name: Port Data Centre at Thrumster
notes: Daily Telegraph reported the planned Tier-3 Port Data Centre at Thrumster was abandoned/scaled down to a modest office with a small data storage room after lack of grant support and investment constraints.

name: DCI CBR01 / Poplars Data Centre Project, Jerrabomberra
notes: Official ESD report places the DCI Canberra Data Centre at 2 Wolseley Place, Jerrabomberra in Queanbeyan-Palerang LGA; trade reporting and agency correspondence describe an 18-20 MW/25.4 MW total power facility, with development consent documents published in 2025.

name: Macquarie Park Data Centre, City of Ryde
notes: NSW Planning Portal approved SSD-10467 on 2021-05-28 for a five-storey 24-hour data storage building with ancillary office space and supporting infrastructure in Macquarie Park.

name: Talavera Road Data Centre Campus Expansion
notes: NSW Planning Portal approved SSD-24299707 on 2024-01-19 for construction and operation of an expansion to an existing data centre campus at 17-23 Talavera Road, Macquarie Park; Mod 1 was determined in December 2024.

name: NEXTDC S5 Data Centre and Innovation Hub
notes: NSW Planning Portal shows the City of Ryde SSD for demolition, site preparation, and construction/operation of NEXTDC S5 at 269 Lane Cove Road, Macquarie Park. NSW Government also named NEXTDC S5 in the IDA data-centre pipeline.

name: 1-5 Khartoum Road Data Centre / EdgeConneX SYD1 MPark
notes: NSW Planning Portal approved SSD-63235720 on 2026-03-11 for the City of Ryde data-storage project; public submissions describe a 76.4 MW facility. Baxtel identifies the Macquarie Park 1-5 Khartoum Road project as EdgeConneX SYD1 MPark developed through a Stockland joint venture.

name: Project Apollo Data Centre Macquarie Park
notes: NSW Planning Portal shows Project Apollo in City of Ryde assessment/more-information-required for a data centre with initial load capacity of about 90 MVA at 4-10 Talavera Road, Macquarie Park; industry listings identify it as a Goodman development.

name: Julius Avenue Data Centre, North Ryde
developer: Undisclosed / applicant not visible in search result
notes: NSW Planning Portal shows SSD-80018208 in assessment/more-information-required for construction and 24/7 operation of a six-storey North Ryde data centre with up to 170 MW power consumption, diesel storage, backup generators, switching station, parking, and a new road.

name: 23-25 Waterloo Road Data Centre
notes: NSW Planning Portal shows SSD-91297457 in Prepare EIS for a 70 MW data centre at 23-25 Waterloo Road, Macquarie Park. DCD reported the Digital Realty-owned legacy data-centre site is proposed for redevelopment.

name: Macquarie Data Centres IC3 Super West
notes: Macquarie Data Centres says IC3 Super West is a 47 MW AI/cloud data centre under construction at its 63 MW Macquarie Park campus, coming online in 2026; a company executive also described a planned co-located engineering and technology campus within a roughly 200 MW Macquarie Park data centre campus.
